info.name: e-JOBS API
info.description:
End-to-end walkthrough of the e-JOBS portal API.

**Run it top to bottom** (Collection Runner, or request by request). Each step feeds the next: the login scripts save the JWTs, Create Job saves {{jobId}}, and Submit Application saves {{applicationId}}. Nothing needs copy-pasting.

**Three tokens, not one.** The API splits by role, so a single {{token}} cannot drive the whole run - creating a job needs the EMPLOYER token, applying needs the JOB_SEEKER one, and the admin endpoints need ROLE_ADMIN. The logins save {{employerToken}}, {{seekerToken}} and {{adminToken}}, and each request sends the right one.

**Credentials** default to the accounts created by LocalDataSeeder (employer@test.com / seeker@test.com / admin@test.com, password Test1234!), so the collection works against a seeded database or an empty one - the Register steps accept 409 as a pass.

**The admin account cannot be registered through the API** - AuthService refuses role=ADMIN. Run the seeder, or the Admin folder will have no token to work with.

Start the API with:
`SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=local ./mvnw spring-boot:run`
